mentions.name: Gangway
mentions.description: A self-hostable tool for quickly deploying small sites and apps for clients and friends. Its ergonomics are similar to Claude artifacts for open source harnesses, it is easily forkable, and it is licensed under Apache 2.
mentions.problem: Quickly deploying small sites and apps for clients and friends.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on https://gangway.sh/

I always wanted to quickly deploy small sites and apps for clients and friends.

While developing this, I realized that this also could be ergonomically similar to Claude artifacts for open source harnesses.

I have a few users that I personally know, but hoping this grows to have more users one day. Not getting abandoned any time soon.

Self hostable and easily forkable with a Apache 2 license.
